summary.answer: Common Hud directly constructs armor overlay wrapper. For a HUDItems.armorOverlay notification, the callback reads model:get(); when that result is not nil, it directly calls RegisterImage(value) and then ArmorOverlayImage:setImage with the returned image. A false model value still passes this nonnil guard; provider errors and rendering remain unverified; ArmorActive delegates IsArmorOverlayActive and hudItems.armorOverlay changes reevaluate state. CallOriginalSecond close registers self.__onClose, outside frozen primary body remains an exact dependency. Optional postload then self return. This displays externally produced armor data; it does not change armor or establish native rendering.

summary.answer: UIImage.new forwards all eight layout arguments to UIElement.new, sets UIImage class, calls setupUIImage and returns self. GetCachedMaterial indexes Materials by requested key; only a nil cache entry calls RegisterMaterial and writes its return to the cache, then returns the cached value. False is a cache hit; a nil RegisterMaterial result can be retried next call. No image/native/material ownership or original runtime contract is supplied.
